title: Hacktoberfest Hack Day Jaunpur 2026 Official Guide
content:
# Hacktoberfest Hack Day Jaunpur 2026

**Date:** Saturday, 24 October 2026
**Timing:** 9:30 AM to 3:00 PM IST
**Location:** Seminar Hall & Computer Center, Block B, Prasad Institute of Technology (PIT), Jaunpur, Uttar Pradesh.

## Event Overview
Hacktoberfest Hack Day Jaunpur is the premier open-source celebration hosted at Prasad Institute of Technology. The event brings together student developers, open-source contributors, and first-time coders across Eastern UP.

## Schedule
- 09:30 AM – 10:00 AM: Check-in, Badge Collection & Welcome Breakfast
- 10:00 AM – 10:30 AM: Opening Keynote & Challenge Briefing (Gemma 4 & MLH Tracks)
- 10:30 AM – 01:00 PM: Hacking Phase 1 & Mentor Round 1
- 01:00 PM – 01:45 PM: Free Networking Lunch & Refreshments (Cafeteria Lawn)
- 01:45 PM – 02:45 PM: Hacking Phase 2, Project Submissions & Pitch Demos
- 02:45 PM – 03:00 PM: Awards Ceremony, Swag Distribution & Closing Photos

## Sponsor Challenges & Free Perks
- **Google Gemma Challenge:** Build applications leveraging Gemma 4 (gemma-4-31b-it / gemma-4-26b-a4b-it) via Google AI Studio free tier.
- **Best Open-Source AI Project:** Rewarding modularity, clean code, documentation, and MIT open-source licensing.
- **Backboard Track:** Free $5 credits for persistent context memory and multi-turn state sync.
- **Render Track:** Free-tier cloud deployments with instant URLs.
- **Free Perk for Attendees:** Every checked-in attendee receives a free 1-year .xyz domain voucher code and official Hacktoberfest stickers.

title: Project Team Formation & Registration Guidelines
content:
# How to Form or Join a Project Team at PIT Jaunpur

## Team Size Rules
- Teams can consist of 1 to 4 members. Cross-department teams (e.g., Computer Science + Information Technology + Electronics) are strongly encouraged.
- Solo participants are allowed, but collaborating in teams is recommended for better project velocity.

## How to Find Teammates
1. **Online Matchmaking:** Join the official PIT Discord server channel `#pit-team-formation` to post your skills (e.g., Frontend, Backend, UI/UX, AI/ML) and find open teams.
2. **In-Person Matchmaking Desk:** If you arrive solo on hackathon morning, visit the Team Matching Desk at the Block B Entrance between 9:30 AM and 10:00 AM. Student coordinators will connect you with peers seeking team members.
3. **Telegram Group:** Join the PIT Student Tech Circle group `@pit_developers` to discuss project ideas.

## Registering Your Team
- Once your team is formed, the team leader must register on the Hack Day Portal by 10:30 AM with:
  - Team Name
  - Member Names, Student Roll Numbers, and College Email IDs
  - Chosen Track / Idea Summary
  - GitHub Repository URL (must be public with an open-source license like MIT).

title: Campus Lost and Found Reporting Protocol
content:
# Campus Lost & Found Reporting Protocol

## Where to Report a Lost or Found Item
- **Physical Office:** Student Welfare Desk (SWD), Ground Floor, Administrative Block A (opposite Room A-104), Prasad Institute of Technology, Jaunpur.
- **Operating Timings:** Monday to Saturday, 9:00 AM to 4:30 PM IST.
- **Helpline Phone:** Internal extension 402 or +91-5452-266500.
- **Official Email:** lostfound@prasad.edu.in

## Protocol for Reporting a Lost Item
1. Visit the Student Welfare Desk or send an email with the subject line `[Lost Item] <Item Name> - <Date>`.
2. Provide exact details:
   - Description of the item (brand, color, serial number, phone model, stickers, or distinguishing marks).
   - Date, time window, and location where you last possessed the item (e.g., Block B Computer Lab 3, Library 2nd floor, or Cafeteria).
   - Your Full Name, Branch/Year, Student Roll Number, and Mobile Contact.
3. The SWD officer logs the report into the central lost property register.

## Protocol for Claiming Found Property
- Found items are deposited in the secure custody room in Block A.
- To claim an item, students must present their physical Student Identity Card and demonstrate proof of ownership (unlocking device screen passcode, invoice copy, or describing unique contents).
- Unclaimed items are securely stored for 30 days before being donated to local charity partners.

title: Campus Facilities, Wi-Fi & Library Hours
content:
# Campus Facilities, Wi-Fi & Central Library

## Campus Wi-Fi Access
- **SSID 1:** `PIT-Student-Secure` — Connect using your student portal admission roll number and student portal password.
- **SSID 2:** `PIT-Campus-Guest` — Available during hackathons and conferences. Open captive portal and enter guest voucher or phone OTP.
- **Bandwidth:** High-speed 1 Gbps NKN leased line enabled across all academic blocks.

## Central Library
- **Location:** Central Block, Floors 1 & 2.
- **Timings:** Monday through Saturday from 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM (extended to 10:00 PM during exam weeks and hackathons).
- **Facilities:** Digital Reference Section with 60 workstations, private group discussion rooms (bookable via library desk), and IEEE/ACM digital access.

## Computer Labs & Coding Society
- **Prasad Coding Society (PCS):** Meets every Wednesday and Saturday from 4:30 PM to 6:00 PM in Computer Lab 2 (Block B).
- **Lab Access:** High-performance Linux and Windows workstations with pre-installed Python, Node.js, Docker, and VS Code.
